x: SLIM (2024) made Japan the 5th country to soft-land on the Moon with its 'Moon sniper' precision landing. The others are mismatched: India's MIP was the 2008 impact probe (NASA's LCROSS was the 2009 polar-crater impactor), Luna-25 (2023) crashed before landing, and Luna 2 (USSR, 1959) was the first to hit the Moon.

EDUSAT (2004) delivered the INSAT system's tele-education service, giving schools and colleges two-way satellite links to virtual classrooms. Disaster warning, hyperspectral land imaging and COSPAS-SARSAT search and rescue are separate functions that EDUSAT did not perform.
TV-D1 flew on 18 Oct 2023 and proved the in-flight abort of the Crew Escape System at Mach 1.2. 24 Aug 2025 was IADT-01, 10 Apr 2026 was IADT-02 and 3 Jul 2026 was the SOLVE ground test.

The Union Cabinet approved the Third Launch Pad at Sriharikota in January 2025, at about ₹4,000 crore, for the NGLV and future human spaceflight. August 2025 was the foundation stone of the SSLV complex at Kulasekarapattinam.
